task1: A WSI of BRAF wildtype colorectal cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of well-formed glandular structures, a pushing or infiltrative tumor border, a desmoplastic stromal reaction, and a moderate degree of tumor heterogeneity without prominent mucinous or medullary growth patterns.
task2: A WSI of RAS wildtype colorectal cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a left-sided or rectal tumor location, a well-defined tumor border, a desmoplastic stromal reaction, and a lower frequency of mucinous differentiation compared to RAS-mutant tumors.
task3: A WSI of MMR-proficient (pMMR) colorectal cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a well-defined tumor border, a desmoplastic stromal reaction, and a lack of prominent peritumoral lymphoid reaction or medullary growth pattern.

task1: A WSI of BRAF mutant colorectal cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a right-sided tumor location, a mucinous or serrated growth pattern, a prominent peritumoral lymphoid reaction, and an infiltrative tumor border with frequent tumor budding.
task2: A WSI of RAS mutant colorectal cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a right-sided tumor location, a mucinous histology with abundant extracellular mucin, an infiltrative tumor border, and a desmoplastic stromal reaction.
task3: A WSI of MMR-deficient (dMMR) colorectal cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a right-sided tumor location, a medullary or mucinous growth pattern, a pushing tumor border, and a prominent peritumoral lymphoid reaction.

task1: A WSI of BRAF wildtype colorectal cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of conventional adenocarcinoma morphology, columnar cells with pseudostratified nuclei, preserved glandular architecture, and a lack of significant lymphocytic infiltration or signet-ring cell features.
task2: A WSI of RAS wildtype colorectal cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of conventional gland-forming adenocarcinoma, a higher likelihood of poorly differentiated histology, and a lower frequency of signet-ring cell features compared to RAS-mutant tumors.
task3: A WSI of MMR-proficient (pMMR) colorectal cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of conventional gland-forming adenocarcinoma, a low number of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and a lack of the morphological features associated with microsatellite instability (MSI).

task1: A WSI of BRAF mutant colorectal cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of poor differentiation, mucinous histology with extracellular mucin pools, signet-ring cell features, a high number of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and a medullary growth pattern with sheets of tumor cells.
task2: A WSI of RAS mutant colorectal cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of mucinous differentiation, signet-ring cell features, a higher frequency of poorly differentiated histology, and a lower frequency of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes compared to RAS wildtype tumors.
task3: A WSI of MMR-deficient (dMMR) colorectal cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of a medullary carcinoma morphology with sheets of tumor cells, a high number of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, mucinous differentiation, a Crohn's-like lymphoid reaction, and a low stroma content.
